xlsx_read_as.title: Renamed sheet?
xlsx_read_as.detail: Sheet {found} has the columns of {sheet} ({score}% match). It is not read unless you choose it.
xlsx_read_as.detail_many: More than one sheet fits {sheet}: {found}. Nothing is picked for you; choose the one to read.
xlsx_read_as.read_as_tip: For this import only. The sheet is not renamed; Apply only writes the ids of new rows into it.
xlsx_read_as.active: Sheet “{found}” is read as {sheet} in this import.
xlsx_read_as.undo_tip: Back to the sheet names as they are in the workbook.
xlsx_read_as.not_rewritten: The workbook was not rewritten: a renamed sheet is read under its own name. Rename it back to keep the workbook in sync.
